{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.dtypes)
print(df.head())
print(df['customer_age'].describe())

# Check for sentinel values
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {(df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")

# Check for invalid revenue values
print(f"Number of 999999.99 in revenue: {(df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {(df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()}")

# Check channel assignment
print(f"Channel distribution: \n{df['channel'].value_counts()}")
print(f"Channel by segment: \n{df.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts()}")

# Check revenue parsing
print(f"Unique revenue values (first 10): {df['revenue'].unique()[:10]}")"}
